plan.name: Identify the exact Python contract stand-in
plan.summary: Extend every missing, changed, extra-file or alternate-package refusal from shipsNaginiStandIn with the original application's nagini_contracts destination and the SHA-256 hashes of both embedded files, preserving D-0260's exact two-file shipping requirement, production-binding protections and rejection before application tests, drivers, backing tests or Nagini execute. A packaged binary reads its own Go build metadata: a clean Git build with a full revision identifies https://github.com/gitdek/invariant/tree/REVISION/internal/verify/naginiruntime/nagini_contracts, explains how to obtain a checkout detached at that revision, and says local verification must use the same revision pinned by the application's CI without claiming that CI has been inspected. Supply one fenced sh copy recipe for a clean build, using explicitly supplied INVARIANT_CHECKOUT and APPLICATION_ROOT directories, checking the checkout revision and both source hashes before creating the destination, and refusing an existing destination rather than overwriting it; unknown, incomplete or modified build metadata must be labeled explicitly, retain the actual embedded-byte hashes, and direct the user to build and run the CI-pinned revision before obtaining copy instructions. Verification itself neither fetches nor installs nor changes application files, and neither a PyPI distribution nor a stand-in injected into staging satisfies shipping; exercise the existing gate fixtures and fakes plus offline packaged builds with clean, absent and modified revision metadata, including executing the emitted copy recipe against a pinned local checkout and importing the shipped package. Update docs/python.md with initial copying, explicit review and replacement of an existing package during upgrades, coordinated CI/local revision pins and verification of the two hashes, and update SPEC.md's in-place-proof requirement citing [#908's ratified plan](.invariant/plans/issue-908.json); the README's existing link to the Python page already covers this detail.

tests.name: TestPythonApplicationStandInRemedies908
tests.says: An exact package still passes; every missing-file, changed-byte, extra-file and alternate-package refusal identifies the original application destination and both expected hashes, preserves the application, and starts no application test, backing test, driver or Nagini.

tests.name: TestPythonApplicationStandInPackagedIdentity908
tests.says: Offline packaged gate builds distinguish clean, unknown and modified build identity without needing their source checkout at runtime, retain their actual embedded-file hashes, and give honest revision-specific CI guidance; the clean build's emitted recipe copies from a pinned local checkout, refuses wrong revisions, changed source bytes and existing destinations, and produces the package the application imports and the gate accepts.
